ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The diagram shows a cube with side length 12 cm. The bold route starts at M near the upper-left front corner. It goes down the left front vertical edge, then horizontally along part of the bottom front edge, then up a vertical segment on the front face, then horizontally right along the remaining top/front portion, then diagonally/back along the top edge of the right face to the far upper-right corner, and finally down the far right vertical edge to N. Reasoning: The two horizontal front-face pieces together span the cube’s full front width, so together they equal one side length, 12 cm. The left vertical segment, the upward vertical segment, the diagonal/back top edge, and the far right vertical segment each have length one cube side, 12 cm. Thus the total path length is 5 side lengths: 5 × 12 = 60 cm.
